referents.why: 'when I made the clouds': the first person in the LORD's speech is the LORD. He is not in this verse's candidate list but is named in 38:1.
'its garment': 'its' is the sea of 38:8, not a candidate.
'its blanket': 'its' is the sea, not a candidate.

links.category: clause nested in a temporal clause

links.why: 'thick darkness its blanket' is inside the same 'when' clause.

'and thick darkness its blanket': a plain and between two lines.
This 'when I made the clouds' is a second temporal clause on the act of 38:8 (shut off the sea); the link points back into 38:8.
